visualCharacteristics.purpose: results heading bar with a heading on the left and links (Back to top, filter chips) on the right, underlined

contentPattern.structure: one row; cells: heading (e.g. All Products), links (e.g. Back to top with href #top)

usage: Partner profile pages, above the partner's product list.
reuseGuidance: Use for a heading + right-aligned link bar above a listing. A link to # or #top scrolls smoothly to the top.
